programme.desc: Bucks County Paranormal Investigations was called in to investigate the beautiful and historic Plumsteadville Inn, Pipersville, PA. Lead investigator Eric Mintel joined by Dave Antonow, Dominic Sattele and Spirit Medium Karen T. Hluchan roamed the halls of this historic structure and encountered many paranormal energies. A discovery, unknown to the owner Matt George, made this investigation one of BCPI's favorite in Bucks County. Follow the clues as we unravel the Mysteries of the Plumsteadville Inn. Eric Mintel and Dominic Sattele meet with Leslie and talk about her report and try to find clues as to what it could be. What follows is a journey into the unknown as more UFO reports ramp up in the same area. What are people seeing!? Eric Mintel Investigates: UFO's over Doylestown PA.
